data.name: hs_attributed_team_ids
data.label: Attributed reporting team
data.description: The set of teams that this deal is attributed to. If an owner is specified at the time of creation, the record will default to the owner's primary team.

data.name: hs_average_call_duration
data.label: Average call duration
data.description: The average call duration of calls associated to the deal

data.name: hs_average_deal_owner_duration_in_current_stage
data.label: Average Deal Owner Duration In Current Stage
data.description: Time duration of the calculated average time of closed-won deals spent in current pipeline stage

data.name: hs_campaign
data.label: HubSpot Campaign
data.description: The marketing campaign the deal is associated with

data.name: hs_closed_amount
data.label: Closed Deal Amount
data.description: Returns the amount if the deal is closed. Else, returns 0.

data.name: hs_closed_amount_in_home_currency
data.label: Closed deal amount in home currency
data.description: The amount in home currency that was closed for deals that were won.

data.name: hs_closed_deal_close_date
data.label: Closed Deal Close Date
data.description: Close date populated only if this deal is closed and valid
data.calculationFormula: if (bool(hs_is_closed) and createdate < closedate) then time_between(closedate, 0) else 0

data.name: hs_closed_deal_create_date
data.label: Closed Deal Create Date
data.description: Create date populated only if this deal is closed
data.calculationFormula: if (bool(hs_is_closed) and createdate < closedate) then time_between(createdate, 0) else 0

data.name: hs_closed_won_count
data.label: Closed won count
data.description: This property is 1 if the deal is closed won, otherwise 0.

data.name: hs_closed_won_date
data.label: Closed Won Date (Internal)
data.description: Returns closedate if this deal is closed won

data.name: hs_created_by_user_id
data.label: Created by user ID
data.description: The user who created this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

data.name: hs_createdate
data.label: HubSpot Create Date
data.description: The date the deal was created. This property is set automatically by HubSpot.

data.name: hs_cross_account_note
data.label: Cross-account note
data.description: Note added by a user when copying a deal to another account.

data.name: hs_cross_sell_opportunity
data.label: Cross-sell Opportunity
data.description: Identify a deal as a good candidate for cross-selling programs.

data.name: hs_days_to_close_raw
data.label: Days to close (without rounding)
data.description: The number of days the deal took to close, without rounding

data.name: hs_deal_amount_calculation_preference
data.label: Deal amount calculation preference
data.description: Specifies how deal amount should be calculated from line items
data.optionsDisplay: TCV (Total Contract Value), ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue), MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue), CUSTOM (Custom)

data.name: hs_deal_registration_mrr
data.label: HubSpot Shared Deal MRR
data.description: MRR of the quote purchased for this Shared Deal.

data.name: hs_deal_registration_mrr_currency_code
data.label: HubSpot Shared Deal MRR Currency Code
data.description: Currency code for the MRR of the quote purchased for this Shared Deal.

data.name: hs_deal_score
data.label: Deal Score
data.description: The predictive deal score calculated by Hubspot AI to score the deal health

data.name: hs_deal_stage_probability
data.label: Deal probability
data.description: The probability a deal will close. This defaults to the deal stage probability setting.

data.name: hs_deal_stage_probability_shadow
data.label: Deal stage probability shadow
data.description: Fall back property for calculating the deal stage when no customer override exist.  Probability between 0 and 1 of deal stage. Defaults to 0 for unknown deal stages.

data.name: hs_exchange_rate
data.label: Exchange rate
data.description: This is the exchange rate used to convert the deal amount into your company currency.

data.name: hs_forecast_amount
data.label: Forecast amount
data.description: The custom forecasted deal value calculated by multiplying the forecast probability and deal amount in your company’s currency.
data.calculationFormula: if is_present(hs_forecast_probability) then (hs_forecast_probability * amount_in_home_currency) else amount_in_home_currency

data.name: hs_forecast_probability
data.label: Forecast probability
data.description: The custom percent probability a deal will close.

data.name: hs_form_id
data.label: Form ID
data.description: ID of the form that created the Deal object

data.name: hs_has_empty_conditional_stage_properties
data.label: Has Empty Conditional Stage Properties
data.description: True if the deal is missing conditional stage property values required to progress to the next deal stage.  This is set automatically by HubSpot based on user actions in the deal record.

data.name: hs_has_last_conversation_follow_ups
data.label: Has Last Conversation Follow Ups
data.description: Indicates if the most recent conversation has follow ups. True if hs_last_conversation_with_followups_object_coordinates has a value, false otherwise.

data.name: hs_has_last_meeting_followups
data.label: Has Last Meeting Follow Ups
data.description: Indicates if the most recent meeting has follow ups. True if hs_last_meeting_id_with_followups has a value, false otherwise.

data.name: hs_is_active_shared_deal
data.label: Is Active Shared Deal
data.description: Indicates if the current deal is an active shared deal. It is set automatically based on the value of hs_num_associated_active_deal_registrations.

data.name: hs_is_closed
data.label: Is Deal Closed?
data.description: True if the deal was won or lost.

data.name: hs_is_closed_count
data.label: Is Closed (numeric)
data.description: This property is 1 if the deal is closed ("Closed Won" or "Closed Lost"), otherwise 0

data.name: hs_is_closed_lost
data.label: Is closed lost
data.description: True if the deal is in the closed lost state, false otherwise
data.calculationFormula: if is_present(hs_deal_stage_probability) and hs_deal_stage_probability <= 0 then true else false

data.name: hs_is_closed_won
data.label: Is Closed Won
data.description: True if the deal is in the closed won state, false otherwise
data.calculationFormula: (if (is_present(pipeline_probability(string(dealstage))) and pipeline_probability(string(dealstage)) >= 1) then true else false)

data.name: hs_is_deal_split
data.label: Deal Split Added
data.description: Indicates if the deal is split between multiple users.
data.calculationFormula: if (is_present(hs_num_associated_deal_splits) and hs_num_associated_deal_splits > 1) then true else false

data.name: hs_is_in_first_deal_stage
data.label: Is In First Deal Stage
data.description: True if the deal is in the first stage of its pipeline. This is set automatically by HubSpot based on user actions in the deal record.

data.name: hs_is_open_count
data.label: Is Open (numeric)
data.description: This property is 1 if the deal is not closed won or closed lost, otherwise 0

data.name: hs_is_stalled
data.label: Is Stalled
data.description: True if Time in stage is 20% longer than the deal owner’s closed-won average time for that stage, false otherwise.

data.name: hs_is_stalled_after_timestamp
data.label: Is Stalled After Timestamp
data.description: Timestamp when Time in stage became 20% longer than the deal owner’s closed-won average for that stage.

data.name: hs_last_call_id_with_followups
data.label: Last call ID with followups
data.description: The object ID of the most recent call that has follow-up items to complete

data.name: hs_last_conversation_with_followups_object_coordinates
data.label: Last conversation with follow-ups
data.description: Object coordinates of the last conversation with followups

data.name: hs_last_email_with_followups_object_coordinates
data.label: Last email with follow-ups
data.description: Object coordinates of the last email with follow-ups

data.name: hs_last_followup_timestamp
data.label: Last follow-up timestamp
data.description: When the most recent conversation or email with follow-ups was recorded for the deal
data.calculationFormula: max(if is_present(string(hs_last_conversation_with_followups_object_coordinates)) then string_to_number(timestamp(hs_last_conversation_with_followups_object_coordinates)) endif, if is_present(string(hs_last_email_with_followups_object_coordinates)) then string_to_number(timestamp(hs_last_email_with_followups_object_coordinates)) endif)

data.name: hs_last_gs_shared_message
data.label: Last GS Shared Message
data.description: when was the last gs shared message?

data.name: hs_last_meeting_id_with_followups
data.label: Last meeting ID with followups
data.description: The object ID of the most recent meeting that has follow-up items to complete

data.name: hs_last_partner_shared_message_date
data.label: Last Partner Shared Message Date

data.name: hs_latest_sales_email_open_date

data.name: hs_latest_sales_email_reply_date
data.label: Latest sales email reply date
data.description: The timestamp of the most recent sales email reply for an associated contact

data.calculationFormula: (if (is_present(hs_likelihood_to_close) and hs_likelihood_to_close >= 0 and hs_likelihood_to_close <= 1 and is_present(amount)) then (hs_likelihood_to_close * amount) endif)
